text: Agent Interactive Terminal 是一款 DSH 网页端终端插件：它通过 bundle 加载插件入口，在 DSH 注册终端工具，并把会话接入共享侧栏面板。agent 可以打开持久 PTY 会话、发送命令或交互输入、等待输出、查看屏幕快照、按键、调整尺寸、列出和关闭会话；用户也能在同一终端接管键盘。终端会话支持持续状态和屏幕投影，适合需要交互式命令行、REPL 或希望与 agent 共看终端的 DSH 用户。使用时需要本机 shell 和 node-pty，插件提供 shell、会话数量及工具策略设置。

Agent Interactive Terminal adds persistent PTY sessions and a shared sidebar to DSH. Agents can open shells, send input, wait for output, inspect screens, press keys, resize, and close sessions. People can watch and take over the same terminal. It requires a local shell and node-pty.
想让 DSH 的 agent 使用能持续保留状态的交互式终端。
有什么办法能和 agent 共用一个命令行窗口并实时看到输出？
让长时间运行的命令可以在终端里继续观察和输入。
我需要在 agent 打开的 shell 里操作 REPL 或 TUI 程序。
DSH 能不能把终端当前屏幕作为快照返回给模型？
希望随时接管 agent 的终端键盘，之后再交还控制权。
I need an interactive shell that keeps its state between agent tool calls.
Let me watch and take over the same terminal session as my agent.
Agent Interactive Terminal 的功能「打开并保持终端会话」：agent 调用 terminal_open 创建带会话编号的 PTY；可指定工作目录、shell、大小和环境变量，并在后续调用中继续使用该会话。
Agent Interactive Terminal 的功能「发送输入并等待结果」：agent 调用 terminal_send 写入文本，可选择提交、匹配屏幕文本或设置静默与超时条件；工具返回屏幕或输出视图及等待状态。
Agent Interactive Terminal 的功能「共享终端屏幕」：用户可在共享面板查看会话并接管键盘；用户持有键盘期间，agent 的写入会排队，交还后再继续处理。
Agent Interactive Terminal 使用前须知：终端会话会在本机启动所选 shell 的 PTY，工具写入的命令会在该 shell 中执行；请准备可用的 shell 与 node-pty 环境。

🖥️ Agent Interactive Terminal

Stateful PTY terminal sessions where an agent and a person share the same screen.

🌐 English · 简体中文
agent-interactive-terminal README · Introduction：

agent-interactive-terminal README · Introduction：> One shared terminal core with two host adapters: a DeepSeek Harness bundle and a Codex/ChatGPT MCP App. Eight `terminal_*` tools, a live shared xterm panel, and password handoff that never enters the model context. Seventy-seven tests pass on Linux with Node 20/22; the full design is in [docs/design.zh.md](docs/design.zh.md).

agent-interactive-terminal README · Why：The usual `exec` tool has no TTY. Programs do not enter interactive mode, long work is invisible, passwords leak into the transcript, and a person cannot share the same shell with the model.

This project turns a terminal into a resource with identity, a screen, a phase, and a lease. The model reads discrete screen snapshots instead of a byte stream; the person can take over, make it read-only, or seal it.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Install：Requires Node.js 20+ and a C++ toolchain for `node-pty`. In DSH, add this index under Plugins → Discover:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AyanamiiiRei/agent-interactive-terminal/main/plugin-market.json
```

Search for `agent-interactive-terminal`, or paste a Git spec under Add plugin. Approve the `node-pty` build script on first install; restart DSH once after upgrading.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/AyanamiiiRei/agent-interactive-terminal.git
cd agent-interactive-terminal
npm install
npm run build

agent-interactive-terminal README · Platforms：Unix shells come first: Linux and macOS use the local zsh/bash; macOS falls back to `/bin/zsh` when `$SHELL` is unset. On Windows the launcher looks for `wsl.exe`: when usable it starts zsh (or bash if zsh is missing) inside WSL and translates the generated rc files to WSL paths. Without WSL it falls back to PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell, or `cmd.exe`. Choosing zsh/bash without WSL fails with an explicit message. Native PowerShell/cmd has no prompt markers, so waits fall back to screen content and output silence: usable, but less precise than WSL.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Quick start：```bash
npm run demo -- "git status"   # one command and the model-facing screen
npm run demo                   # interactive loop: /snap, /wait, /key, /resize, /quit
npm run attach                 # browser attach demo, open the printed address
```

agent-interactive-terminal README · Inside DSH：The terminal icon lives in the session header. Opening it shows an xterm panel on the right; session tabs are numbered in their current order and close on middle click. While the agent is active, the top bar and the area below the terminal carry an RGB running light.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Inside DSH：- **Keyboard ownership**: typing takes the lease; a few idle seconds hand it back. Agent writes queue during that window, with the queued command and a cancel button in the top bar, then drain in order after handback.
- **Access levels**: `collaborate`, `observe` (read-only), and `sealed` (no read or write; the list keeps only a redacted record). Read-only and sealed refuse queueing and return distinct errors.
- **Tool policy**: interactive first by default; one-shot first and terminal only are the alternatives. Terminal only hides bash from the agent. A separate switch steers REPL work into python and similar interactive sessions.
- **Settings**: theme, font, cursor, shortcuts, scrollback, bell, copy/paste, and lease timeout. The theme follows DSH by default and can be pinned to a fixed palette.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Inside Codex：The same core also ships as an MCP stdio server plus a Codex plugin. After building, add the repository to Codex's plugin marketplaces:

```bash
npm install && npm run build
codex plugin marketplace add /path/to/agent-interactive-terminal
codex plugin add agent-interactive-terminal@agent-interactive-terminal
```

agent-interactive-terminal README · Inside Codex：Start `codex` and ask it to open a terminal; the `terminal_open` result carries a local panel URL. Open that page to share the shell, take over, make it read-only, seal it, and answer password prompts. See [docs/codex.zh.md](docs/codex.zh.md) for the full walkthrough.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Inside Codex：The same terminal can also appear beside the conversation in the ChatGPT desktop app, which ships Codex as its agent. The `interactive_terminal` tool declares a `thread` entrypoint through MCP Extensions; after restarting the desktop app and opening a new Codex chat, choose **Interactive Terminal** in the side panel. The window embeds the same React panel used by the DSH adapter, with the MCP stdio transport adapted to the panel's attach protocol. That panel and Codex's built-in **Terminal** are separate: the built-in one is Codex's own PTY, while Interactive Terminal drives this project's `terminal_*` session, with screen snapshots, waits, a takeover lease, and read-only/sealed access.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Inside Codex：Without the plugin marketplace, register the MCP server directly:

```bash
codex mcp add ait -- node /path/to/agent-interactive-terminal/plugins/codex/bin/ait-mcp.mjs
```

The MCP server and panel also run on their own:

```bash
npm run mcp          # or node dist/mcp/cli.js after a build
npm run panel        # standalone panel with a manually opened shell
```

agent-interactive-terminal README · From code：`createTerminalTools(registry)` exposes the same surface to another model runtime. A password prompt makes `wait` return `human_required` and suspends the agent; answer with `session.write(secret, { origin: 'human' })`, and the secret never reaches the model. The `npm run attach` browser demo binds `127.0.0.1` only and has no authentication; it is an example, not a deployment.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `terminal_open` | Open a session, returning id, status line, and initial screen |
| `terminal_send` | Write text (Enter by default) and wait for a settlement |
| `terminal_wait` | Wait without writing |
| `terminal_snapshot` | Read the screen or output tail, with optional row deltas |
| `terminal_key` | Press a named key such as `ctrl-c`, `enter`, or `page-down` |
| `terminal_resize` | Resize the terminal |
| `terminal_close` | Close the session and its process tree |
| `terminal_list` | List sessions, phases, sizes, and directories |

agent-interactive-terminal README · Repository layout：One repository, one `main` branch. The session core, tools, and protocol are shared; host-specific code stays in adapters rather than in a long-lived fork.

```
src/screen/        headless xterm screen model
src/pty/           node-pty and foreground inspection
src/session/       sessions, registry, shell launch
src/tools/         the eight tools

agent-interactive-terminal README · Repository layout：The Codex adapter imports the DSH `TerminalPanel` / `TerminalView` React component and supplies an MCP-backed transport instead of a WebSocket. The GitHub repository is the source of truth for both hosts; a separate branch is only for short-lived experiments, not for maintaining the Codex port.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Design：One screen, two projections: text for the model and serialized ANSI for the browser. Writing is an action, waiting is a query, and state is a fact; the three stay separate. Authorization is fixed when the session opens and enforced by the server, not by dropping keys in the browser.

agent-interactive-terminal README · Status：Implemented: screen snapshots, waits, leases, password handoff, secret injection, auditing, zsh/bash integration, the shared panel, and macOS/Windows WSL launch. Not yet implemented: redaction beyond the audit preview, idle session reclamation, and fish integration. See [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) for the full list and deliberate non-goals.
